nodes.name: Sklearn Spectral Clustering Wrapper Helpers
nodes.description: Deterministic public-wrapper helpers for spectral_clustering above the deferred SpectralClustering.fit path.

nodes.name: spectral_clustering_precomputed_affinity
nodes.description: Expose the fixed affinity='precomputed' override passed by spectral_clustering into SpectralClustering.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Manifold learning, biclustering or spectral decomposition constructs similarity/projection matrices, taking quadratic time/space in samples.

nodes.name: spectral_clustering_return_labels
nodes.description: Return the fitted cluster label vector exposed by spectral_clustering.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.
